aliases.policy: Each core hx- attribute also admits data-hx- spelling.

inheritance.default: implicit for attributes explicitly marked implicit above
inheritance.optOut: hx-disinherit="*" or named attributes; unset stops a value
inheritance.optIn: hx-inherit names attributes when config.disableInheritance is enabled; computed config is unknown

trigger.form: comma-separated event[JavaScript-filter] modifier* or every interval[filter]; from/target/root selectors preserve their selector parts
trigger.filterOwner: EMB0 attaches authored JavaScript; values are never executed; template holes retain unknown parts.

swap.form: optional style followed by whitespace-separated name:value modifiers
swap.policy: Decode authored strategy, timing and target only. No live swap, settle phase, history state or runtime class fact.

profiles.extensionPolicy: No external extension semantics admitted: the core tarball does not pin separately distributed 2.x extension packages. Literal defineExtension names can bind hx-ext uses without evaluating implementations.

registration.uses: hx-ext comma-separated names; ignore:name removes an inherited extension

responseTemplateSyntax.policy: Static authored response marker; not an hx-partial attribute. Fragment interpretation belongs to HRF1/HRF2.

inheritance.implicitCompatibility: config.implicitInheritance is a runtime setting; do not assume its evaluation. Facts describe authored default-profile rules or remain conditional.

trigger.form: HCON-aware comma-separated event[JavaScript-filter] plus HCON modifier pairs; quoted values and nested brackets preserve inner commas
trigger.filterOwner: EMB0 attaches authored JavaScript; values are never executed; template holes retain unknown parts.
trigger.queueNote: No hx-trigger queue modifier is interpreted by the pinned #onTrigger; hx-sync supplies request scheduling strategy. HCON parses additional authored keys without proving their semantics.

swap.form: optional leading style followed by HCON modifier pairs or JSON
swap.policy: Decode authored strategy, timing and target only. No live swap, settle phase, history state or runtime class fact.

eventPatterns.policy: Authored custom template type, not an invented finite event.
